title: ficus euomphala
intro: Ficus euomphala, commonly known as the Indian banyan, is a type of fig tree native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects that may help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and neutralize free radicals. The therapeutic actions of Ficus euomphala are believed to be attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve wound healing, and exhibit analgesic and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
